descriptions.w3d_d24e_register_weapon_panel_propertie: Resets the WeaponGrafixID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the DataContainerID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the LockedID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the PageID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the TypeID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the ToolTipID string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; sets the BorderResource string binding (0x801ed24c) to a temporary string made from "FE.Brd.%s" (0x803b76e4, constructor 0x8020bb54); registers BorderColour (0x801ece2c); resets the HighlightedMessage string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the SelectedMessage string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
